description.zh:
- 版本类型，必须选择一个版本

- 通用版本：translate_standard

- 专业版本：translate_ecommerce
description.en:
- Version type. You must select one version:  

- General-purpose Edition: translate_standard  

- Professional Edition: translate_ecommerce

description.zh: 翻译文本的格式，**html**（ 网页格式。设置此参数将对待翻译文本以及翻译后文本按照html格式进行处理）、**text**（文本格式。设置此参数将对传入待翻译文本以及翻译后结果不做文本格式处理，统一按纯文本格式处理。
description.en: The format of the text to translate: **html** (web page format; when this parameter is set, both the source text and the translated text are processed as HTML) or **text** (plain text format; when this parameter is set, neither the source text nor the translation result undergoes any formatting treatment and is uniformly handled as plain text).

description.zh: 场景，支持：通用（general）、商品标题（title）、商品详情（description）、买卖家沟通（message）、医疗（medical）、社交（social）、科技（tech）。
description.en: Scenario. Supported values include: general, title (product title), description (product description), message (buyer-seller communication), medical, social, and tech.
Source language. For language codes, see [Language Code Reference](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158269.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.6.542.7da22b9fayuNoj).
Target language. For language codes, see the reference.

title.zh: 创建文本异步翻译任务
title.en: Create a text asynchronous translation job

descriptions.zh: 1、机器异步翻译字符长度上限是100万字符  2、文本异步翻译创建接口参考阿里云OpenAPI开发者门户调试调用
descriptions.en: 1. The maximum character length for machine asynchronous translation is 1 million characters. 2. For the text asynchronous translation job creation API, refer to the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI Developer Portal to debug and invoke the API.
